paper.title: Algorithm 385: Exponential integral Ei(x) (Collected Algorithms from ACM)

stack: Fortran 77 (netlib TOMS 385.gz shell archive: Fortran/Dp/Src/src.f with DEI, driver Fortran/Dp/Drivers/driver.f, Makefile, shipped res)

claim.text: TEST01 of the shipped driver: DEI(2.0), the exponential integral, as printed in the Computed column of the shipped res file (row X = 2.0000), is 4.9542344. Registered by scout from the artifact's own reference output. Tolerance 2e-7 absolute, fixed before any run.
claim.determinism: deterministic (fixed argument X = 2.0 from the driver's table; no random input)

attempt: G1: the authors' Makefile in the shipped layout stops at once with 'No rule to make target src.f, needed by src.o' because src.f sits in Fortran/Dp/Src, not beside the Makefile (log kept). The build then runs the Makefile's own rules as separate commands with the src.f path set to ../Src (gfortran 16.2.0, default flags). No source file changed: the pre, mid and post manifests of the authors' sources are identical, so this is a build-only patch. The driver's whole output is identical to the shipped res (diff exit 0), so the X = 2.0 value matches the reference line for line. Gfortran warnings only.

original_attempt.reason: make stops with 'No rule to make target src.f, needed by src.o': the archive places src.f in ../Src while the Makefile expects it in the same directory.
